method: 2D HCurl(Nedelec1)+H1(P1) mixed quadratic beta Maxwell FEM; beta_squared sparse shift-invert
convention: exp(i beta z - i omega t); Im(neff)>0 is passive loss

warnings: PML loss needs independent mesh, window, thickness, strength and order validation
field independence and weak Gauss diagnostics do not prove all spurious modes absent
named fiber geometry and material assumptions remain those of the design

input.name: Synthetic MCF numerical example; not commercial fiber

metadata.constant_index_basis: explicit synthetic optical contrast; no commercial specification or measured material claim

wall_resolution.basis: circular-wall radial segment / linear triangle intersection; sampled only

wavelength_resolution.scope: phase wavelength resolution only; PML stretching and absorption skin depth not certified

design_diagnostics.material_basis: materials.* defines optical index; parameter delta_n does not override it
assumptions: air model uses constant n=1.00027; not pressure/temperature calibrated
no implicit Ge/F Sellmeier or stress-rod composition

notes: Compatibility policy: bulk wavelength resolution is measured, NOT enforced; select wavelength for whole-domain limit
mesh_quality.validation_status: geometry/mesh diagnostics only; optical convergence not established

modes.alpha_basis: signed total Im(neff): radiative + material; independent input-matched study required
modes.gauss_basis: interior H1 test functions; scalar-mass dual norm / (k0 * L2 norm of untransformed epsilon E)

classification.Aeff_basis: Et=Ex,Ey only; FEM cell-average diagnostic; PML excluded
classification.normalization: physical-domain longitudinal Poynting flux = 1 W; global phase fixed
classification.field_content_basis: longitudinal energy fractions with heuristic 1e-6 threshold, not a symmetry irrep
classification.MFD_PetermannII_status: TODO: full radial field or verified far-field transform required
classification.symmetry_class: mirror x=mixed_or_asymmetric, y=mixed_or_asymmetric; not an automatic HE/TE/TM label

field_samples.sampling: quadrature cell average plotted at triangle centroid; not a nodal field

tracking_fields.basis: actual mixed finite-element interpolation on fixed physical-domain probes
